verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents a 'Fivetran Alerts' dashboard page, though the evidence gives only its title. Its official MCP server can answer sync-status questions such as whether the last sync succeeded or whether any connections are broken, which shows per-connection run status is exposed. Missing for 10: documented sync logs, per-sync row counts, failure alert delivery to Slack, email, or registrable outbound webhooks, any detail on what Alerts covers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I see run status, logs, and row counts per sync, and failures alert me in Slack, email, or a webhook

citations.quote: It allows you to ask read-only questions like "when was the last time my postgres connection completed a sync?" and "are any of my connections broken?"
It lets you ask questions like "was my last postgres sync successful" and "are any of my connections broken" and have the model answer the questions for you.
